answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cipher is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the prism. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the vine is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
